name: cavemio-activity-heatmap
title: Activity heatmap
description: Every day as a square, weeks across: one readout glides to the day you point at, and new numbers ripple through week by week.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Grey in a new shadcn project? Its default theme sets --chart-1 to --chart-5 to greys. Set five colours, light and dark, as in Theming › Chart colours (/ui/theming#charts).
- The grid is an ARIA grid with one tab stop: arrow keys move a day (up and down) or a week (left and right), and each day’s label reads its count and full date.
- The readout pill is aria-hidden; the focused day’s own label carries the same words.
- Dates are read as calendar days in UTC, so a day never shifts with the visitor’s time zone. Month and weekday names wait for hydration before using the visitor’s language.
- Colours mix from one colour (default --chart-3) into your background in four steps; empty days are a light step of your foreground.
- It sizes to its own width: as many weeks as fit at 10px a day or more, up to 16px.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion the days change in place and the readout jumps.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: data
props.description: – · Days as { date: "YYYY-MM-DD", value }, in any order; missing days are zero.

props.name: end
props.description: the latest day in data · The last day shown.

props.name: weeks
props.description: 26 · The most weeks to show; fewer when the card is narrow.

props.name: weekStart
props.description: 0 · The first row: 0 for Sunday, 1 for Monday.

props.name: unit
props.description: { one: "contribution", other: "contributions" } · What’s being counted, in the readout and the total.

props.name: color
props.description: var(--chart-3) · The colour of the busiest days; the lighter steps are mixed from it.

props.name: thresholds
props.description: – · Lower bounds of levels 1 to 4, instead of the data’s quartiles.

props.name: title / description / action
props.description: – · The header: a title, a line under it and something beside it, such as a metric switch.

props.name: locales
props.description: – · For numbers, month and weekday names.

props.name: onDayClick
props.description: – · Called when a day is clicked or Enter is pressed on it.

useCases.title: Developer and contribution profiles
useCases.description: Commits, deploys or reviews per day, the way GitHub shows them.

useCases.title: Shop and sales dashboards
useCases.description: Orders or new customers per day, so busy weekdays and quiet weeks stand out.

useCases.title: Habit and streak apps
useCases.description: Days done across months, with the gaps in plain sight.

useCases.title: Usage and audit pages
useCases.description: Logins, API calls or events per day for an account or a team.

features.title: Just a list of days
features.description: Pass dates and counts in any order; missing days count as zero and the weeks are built for you.

features.title: Levels from your data
features.description: Four steps from the data’s own quartiles, or the bounds you pass.

features.title: A readout that never covers
features.description: One pill on a rail above the grid glides to the day you point at and rests on the busiest one.

features.title: Read one band
features.description: Point at a step of the legend and only the days in it stay bright.

features.title: Fits its width
features.description: It shows as many weeks as fit at a readable size, newest on the right.

features.title: Keyboard and screen readers
features.description: A real grid: one tab stop, arrow keys, Home and End, and each day’s count and date as its label.

states.title: arrive
states.description: In view for the first time, the days fill in from the oldest week to the newest (520ms each, 16ms per week) and the total rolls up from zero.

states.title: point
states.description: Pointing at a day rings it and glides the readout to its week (300ms); the count rolls and the date morphs. With nothing pointed at, the readout rests on the busiest day.

states.title: level
states.description: Pointing at a step of the legend dims every day outside that band to 22%.

states.title: data
states.description: New values or a new colour change each day’s fill with the same week-by-week delay, so the change ripples across.

states.title: keyboard
states.description: One tab stop on the grid; arrow keys move a day or a week, Home and End go to the first and last day, Enter calls onDayClick.
